evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies src/addrman.cpp to fix peer sampling behavior within address manager buckets.
rationale: Eliminates severe sampling bias in sparse address manager buckets that skews peer connection selection. In buckets with few entries, sequential offset scanning created dramatic probability imbalances (e.g. 95.3% vs 4.7% in a two-entry bucket), degrading eclipse resistance and uniform peer connectivity.
